label: Scatter-gather (Search execution model)
type: the execution model the Search Service uses for every query when multiple nodes run the service - a search:coordinator-node scatters the request, then gathers results back.
evidence: The Search Service uses a scatter-gather process for running all Search queries, when there are multiple nodes in the cluster running the Search Service.
relates_to_competency_question: How does a Search query executed against a multi-node cluster actually run - does one node handle everything, or is the work distributed?
